mentions.name: Recipe Card Creator (Sunny Shores Creative)
mentions.description: A tool for creating recipe cards, built as a hobby project over 7 months with the goal of becoming the best recipe card creator available.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building what I hope will become the best recipe card creator out there. I've spent about 7 months in it now and it's way better than where we started.
